name: Call of Abdulov
storyline: Russia was gripped by an epidemic of a terrible virus that distorts the mind and the body of the people, turning them into dumb and ugly monsters. Only you can stop the source of infection and to save the world, not allowing further spread of infection.
summary: Old-school brutal first-person shooter in Serious Sam style on the theme of Abduloreligion (famous russian parody religion). Russia was gripped by an epidemic of a terrible virus that distorts the mind and the body of the people, turning them into dumb and ugly monsters. Only you can stop the source of infection and to save the world, not allowing further spread of infection. You have to go through a long and hard way from 30+ levels: to visit the cities filled with evil creatures; stroll along a remote Russian village; to visit the past, and to participate in the Kuril landing operation of 1945; learn the spooky secrets of unit 731 etc. In addition to the regular weapons in the game will also be available and equipment: tanks, helicopters, military robots.
